connectionSpecification.description: Reads the users, databases, pages and blocks shared with a Notion internal integration.

access_token.description: Secret of a Notion internal integration (https://www.notion.so/profile/integrations) with the capability "Read content", and "Read user information including email addresses" for the users stream. Pages and databases are visible to it once shared with it under ⋯ → Connections. It is sent in the Authorization header.
access_token.title: Internal Integration Token

lookback_minutes.description: An incremental read starts this many minutes before the saved last_edited_time, because Notion rounds last_edited_time to the minute and its search index lags behind edits. 0 or more.
lookback_minutes.title: Lookback Window (minutes)

max_block_depth.description: How deep blocks are read under a page. Between 1 and 100. A page with blocks nested deeper fails the read.
max_block_depth.title: Maximum Block Depth

max_blocks_per_page.description: How many blocks are read under one page. 1 or more. A page with more fails the read.
max_blocks_per_page.title: Maximum Blocks per Page

connectionSpecification.title: Notion Source Spec
